bugs.title: Signature compared with a non-constant-time operator
bugs.rationale: String comparison returns at the first differing byte, which leaks how much of a forged signature is correct through timing; use hmac.compare_digest.

acceptable.rationale: No idempotency/replay protection within the tolerance window; malformed data raises 500.
